title: Property Template
description: A property-based test template. The orchestrator's property gate compiles a template into an executable harness by binding parameter types to generators and substituting placeholders into the invariant string.

languages.description: Languages this template supports. The property gate selects a template whose language list contains the discovered target's language.

targetType.description: Shape of the target the template applies to. Pure-function: deterministic input→output, no side effects. Mutation: in-place modification of an argument. Invariant: a property that must hold across a sequence of operations.

generators.description: Map of parameter type names → generator references. Type names match the discovered target's parameter type hints (e.g. 'int', 'str', 'any'). Generator references are language-specific symbol paths the property gate resolves at harness compile time (e.g. 'hypothesis.strategies.integers', 'fast-check.anything').

invariant.description: Template string describing the invariant the harness asserts. May contain {{fn}}, {{args}}, and other placeholders the property gate substitutes when emitting the harness body.

message.description: Finding message emitted on counterexample. May contain {{fn}} and {{counterexample}} placeholders.
